answer: Use challenge-bound admission bonds with delayed cash-out. 1) Each fresh key locks 40 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established peers from separate funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied output fingerprints, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 40,000 POA, risks 20,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like velvet over tundra, an orchard hides no duplicate roots when every trail is audited.
